## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a [Conventional Commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `ci:`, `chore:` …). It becomes the squash-merge commit and drives release-please
- [ ] Breaking changes are marked with `!` (e.g. `feat!:`) and explained above
- [ ] Local checks from CONTRIBUTING.md pass
- [ ] Docs/README updated if inputs, outputs, or behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, account/subscription/tenant IDs, or internal hostnames
